words.exampleEn: The detective solved the mystery quickly.
words.exampleCn: 侦探很快破解了这个谜团。

words.exampleEn: The mechanic fixed my car's engine.
words.exampleCn: 修理工修好了我汽车的发动机。

words.exampleEn: The reporter wrote a story about the fire.
words.exampleCn: 记者写了一篇关于那场火灾的报道。

words.exampleEn: The sailor worked on a big ship.
words.exampleCn: 那名水手在一艘大船上工作。

words.exampleEn: The government uses tax money to build parks.
words.exampleCn: 政府用税收收入修建公园。

words.exampleEn: He has a desire to be a great artist.
words.exampleCn: 他渴望成为一名伟大的艺术家。

words.exampleEn: We use our eyes for the sense of sight.
words.exampleCn: 我们用眼睛来产生视觉。

words.exampleEn: This candy has a sweet taste.
words.exampleCn: 这种糖有甜味。

words.exampleEn: Taste it and see if you think there's enough salt in it.
words.exampleCn: 尝尝看，你觉得盐够不够。

words.exampleEn: The author signed copies of her new book.
words.exampleCn: 这位作者在她的新书上签名。

words.exampleEn: The fashion designer created a beautiful dress.
words.exampleCn: 这位时装设计师设计了一条漂亮的裙子。

words.cn: 休息日（不用工作的日子）
words.exampleEn: Tuesday is my day off from work.
words.exampleCn: 星期二是我的休息日。

words.exampleEn: Good students focus on their studies.
words.exampleCn: 好学生专注于学业。

words.exampleEn: She works a full-time job at the hospital.
words.exampleCn: 她在医院做全职工作。

words.exampleEn: He has a part-time job at the bakery.
words.exampleCn: 他在面包店有一份兼职工作。

words.exampleEn: I don't have a job now.
words.exampleCn: 我现在没有工作。

words.exampleEn: Teaching is a rewarding career.
words.exampleCn: 教书是一份有意义的职业。

words.exampleEn: Every employee gets a lunch break.
words.exampleCn: 每位员工都有午餐休息时间。

words.exampleEn: Travel gives you valuable life experience.
words.exampleCn: 旅行能给你宝贵的人生经验。

words.exampleEn: The store manager helps customers.
words.exampleCn: 店长帮助顾客。

words.exampleEn: The school staff includes teachers and nurses.
words.exampleCn: 学校全体员工包括老师和护士。

words.exampleEn: Scientists study planetary movement.
words.exampleCn: 科学家研究行星运动。

words.exampleEn: The organisation helps protect animals.
words.exampleCn: 这个组织帮助保护动物。

words.exampleEn: Polar bears live in the Arctic.
words.exampleCn: 北极熊生活在北极。

words.exampleEn: We landed on the surface of the moon.
words.exampleCn: 我们在月球表面着陆。

words.exampleEn: The rover sent photos from Mars.
words.exampleCn: 探测车从火星传回了照片。

words.exampleEn: Flowers grow all year in the greenhouse.
words.exampleCn: 温室里一年四季都开花。

words.exampleEn: We built a shelter from sticks and leaves.
words.exampleCn: 我们用树枝和树叶搭了一个遮蔽处。

words.exampleEn: Some mushrooms are toxic and unsafe to eat.
words.exampleCn: 有些蘑菇有毒，不能食用。

words.exampleEn: The wind blows dust into the house.
words.exampleCn: 风把灰尘吹进屋里。

words.exampleEn: She was brave and spoke in front of the class.
words.exampleCn: 她很勇敢，在全班面前发了言。

words.exampleEn: My mum is a professional artist.
words.exampleCn: 我妈妈是一位职业艺术家。

words.exampleEn: I had a worry about the test.
words.exampleCn: 我对这次考试有些担心。

words.exampleEn: He spoke seriously about the rules.
words.exampleCn: 他严肃地讲了这些规定。

words.exampleEn: The submarine went deep into the ocean.
words.exampleCn: 潜水艇潜入了海洋深处。

words.exampleEn: Flowers attract bees with their colours.
words.exampleCn: 花用颜色吸引蜜蜂。
